answer.rationale: A release 2 hours ago coincides with p99 latency climbing 5x above target, confined to the primary region. memory_b1 demonstrates that rollback is a proven path to clearing checkout errors with no customer impact. memory_b6 shows gating catches regressions within an hour. Current timing and symptoms match the pattern from memory_b1. Rollback is the fastest reversal path during peak settlement traffic when writes cannot be lost. Regional failover would preserve writes but move risk; add_capacity under peak load is slow; circuit breakers and read routing do not address write path latency. A small guarded test (canary rollback to prior build) mitigates rollback risk while we verify the release is the root cause.
